title: TUI drill-down + plan ordering by status
task_body: From the plans pane, ENTER drills into a detail view; ESC pops back. Plans are ordered by status so active work is on top. Keymap and mode model gain drill-down state; the detail pane renders one plan's worth of context.
rationale: Mode model + state hold the drill stack; keymap binds the keys; render dispatches; detail pane is the new view; plan_counts owns the status sort.
